title: Distance Between ZIP Codes: Miles & Midpoint
description: Enter two US ZIP codes in Distance Between ZIP Codes for the straight-line distance, bearing and midpoint between their centroids. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, ZIP 10001 (New York) to 90210 (Beverly Hills) measures approx. 2,453 miles (3,948 km) between centroids — while 10001 to 60601 (Chicago) is a shorter 710 miles.
quick_answer: Distance Between ZIP Codes measures the straight-line distance between any two US ZIP codes, using the published centroid of each code. Enter two 5-digit ZIPs and read the distance in miles and kilometres with the initial bearing and the midpoint, both centroids pinned on the map for a visual check.

faq: What exactly is a ZIP centroid?

The representative point published for that ZIP code — roughly its populated centre. Distances are measured between centroids, which is why the tool calls its results area-to-area rather than door-to-door.
Why is my ZIP not found?

ZIPs are added, split and retired by USPS over time, and a few are non-geographic (PO-box or single-organisation codes). Try the neighbouring residential ZIP; the dataset covers standard geographic codes.
What is the 'M' pin on the map?
The midpoint of the two centroids — the same halfway calculation as the dedicated midpoint tools, drawn so you can see where 'halfway between the ZIPs' actually falls.
Enter the 5-digit base ZIP. The +4 extension refines delivery within the same area and does not change an area-to-area distance.
How accurate is it for rural ZIPs?
Rural ZIPs can span many miles, so a centroid distance can differ from any specific address pair inside them by that much. For exact addresses, measure the two points in Distance Between Two Places.
Does it work for Canadian postal codes or UK postcodes?
No — this tool is US ZIPs only. The UK equivalent is the UK Postcode Distance Calculator, built on postcodes.io data.
